mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = #{boardType}
AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = #{boardType} AND (REGIST_DT < #{registDt} OR (REGIST_DT = #{registDt} AND BOARD_ID < #{boardId})) ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC, BOARD_ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE = #{boardType} AND (REGIST_DT > #{registDt} OR (REGIST_DT = #{registDt} AND BOARD_ID > #{boardId})) ORDER BY REGIST_DT ASC, BOARD_ID ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT BOARD_ID, BOARD_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, NOTICE_YN, IMPORTANT_YN, MAIL_SENT_YN, MAIL_SENT_DT, VIEW_CNT, REGIST_DT, REGISTER FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD ( BOARD_ID, BOARD_TYPE, TITLE, SEARCH_CHOSUNG, CONTENT, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, NOTICE_YN, IMPORTANT_YN, VIEW_CNT, REGIST_DT, REGISTER ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{searchChosung}, #{content}, #{atchFileGrpid}, COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{importantYn}, 'N'), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET SMS_SENT_YN = 'Y', SMS_SENT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND COALESCE(SMS_SENT_YN, 'N') = 'N'
UPDATE BOARD SET MAIL_SENT_YN = 'Y', MAIL_SENT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND MAIL_SENT_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COMMENT_ID, BOARD_ID, CONTENT, REGISTER, REGISTER_NM, REGIST_DT FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY REGIST_DT ASC, COMMENT_ID ASC
SELECT COMMENT_ID, BOARD_ID, CONTENT, REGISTER, REGISTER_NM FROM BOARD_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_COMMENT ( COMMENT_ID, BOARD_ID, CONTENT, REGISTER, REGISTER_NM, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{commentId}, #{boardId}, #{content}, #{register}, #{registerNm}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
